reasoning: I was unable to locate any Utah-specific general-election polling for the 2026 presidential or Senate races in the last 45 days, nor any recent race ratings from national forecasters for those contests. Recent Utah data instead focuses on Trump job approval and issue polling, which suggests Republicans remain structurally favored but does not provide a direct head-to-head margin for a specific race. Given the absence of fresh, race-specific polls, the most concrete quantitative guidance is Utah’s R+11 Cook Partisan Voting Index, indicating a strong Republican lean at the statewide level, with current issue and approval polling broadly consistent with that structural advantage but not convertible into a precise D+/R+ race margin.
